title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 12: the warriors who joined David at Ziklag and the tribes who came to Hebron to make him king.

questions.text: To which place did the mighty men in the first verses come to David while he was a fugitive from Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 12:1 says these men came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish.

questions.text: What skill did the Benjamite warriors who came to David have?
questions.explanation: They were armed with bows and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and shooting arrows.

answers.text: They could use both the right hand and the left
They were skilled at driving chariots
They could swim across the Jordan
They were trained to fight on horseback

questions.text: The faces of the Gadites who joined David were like the faces of what?
questions.explanation: The Gadites had faces like the faces of lions and were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains.

questions.text: What was the Jordan like when the Gadites went over it in the first month?
questions.explanation: They went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks.

answers.text: It was frozen over from bank to bank
It was blocked by a dam
It had overflowed all its banks

questions.text: On whom did the Spirit come, so that he said, "We are yours, David"?
questions.explanation: The Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the thirty, and he said, "We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse."

questions.text: Why did the lords of the Philistines send David away when he came with them against Saul?
questions.explanation: After consultation they said, "He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads."

answers.text: He had refused to fight against Israel
His men were too few to be of any use
They feared he would desert to his master Saul
A prophet warned them in a dream at night

questions.text: Who is described as "a young man mighty of valor" who came with twenty-two captains of his father's house?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 names Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, with twenty-two captains of his father's house.

questions.text: Which tribe had men who "had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do"?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says this of the children of Issachar, whose heads were two hundred.

questions.text: How long were the men with David at Hebron, eating and drinking?
questions.explanation: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

questions.text: Which of these is listed among the supplies that were brought on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen?
questions.explanation: Verse 40 lists flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.
